## Type of Change

Please mark the applicable options:

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality or new component)

- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (updates to README, WIKI, or component docs)

## Verification & Testing Checklist

Please ensure each of the following commands succeeds locally before submitting:

- [ ] `npm run test` - Unit and interaction tests pass and meet coverage thresholds
- [ ] `npm run lint` - ESLint static analysis passes with zero errors
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` - TypeScript compiler passes with zero errors
- [ ] `npm run build` - Production bundle builds successfully

## Documentation & Storybook Check

- [ ] Storybook stories added or updated (`src/stories/`)
